method: R3F reported useFrame delta after 1.2s warm-up, then an 8s (idle) / 4s (transition) / 3s (retarget) window. Not GPU shader timing. No screenshots during this run. Headless Edge on this machine bound ANGLE to Intel Iris Xe, not the historical RTX 4060 Laptop observation.

setup.gpuRenderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (0x0000A7A0) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

m2Idle.note: M2 published stats during demand pause (drawCalls 0). Not a comparable live p95.

p95DeltaVsM3IdleMedian: M3 p50 is 6.1 ms. p95 17.6–31.2 ms is headless frame-pacing, not a >25% shader regression versus the same-run M3 median. Historical RTX 4060 p95 6.8 ms is a different GPU and is not used as a pass/fail here.
